WITH t AS (SELECT calendar_date FROM dim_date WHERE is_trading_day AND (calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26'))
SELECT t.calendar_date FROM t WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=139 AND f.sale_date=t.calendar_date)
SELECT * FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=139 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-12-28' AND DATE '2025-01-08' ORDER BY 1

WITH f AS (SELECT s.store_id, f.sale_date AS d, sum(f.net_amount) AS net_fact FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id<900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2026-01-25' GROUP BY 1,2),
r AS (SELECT store_id, business_date AS d, net_sales_before_returns AS net_rpt, returns_net, net_sales FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2026-01-25')
SELECT CASE WHEN f.d<=DATE '2025-01-26' THEN 'pri' WHEN f.d>=DATE '2025-10-27' THEN 'cur' ELSE 'gap' END AS per, count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN r.d IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_in_rpt, sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.net_fact-coalesce(r.net_rpt,0))>0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mismatch, sum(f.net_fact) AS fact, sum(r.net_rpt) AS rpt, sum(r.returns_net) AS rets, sum(r.net_sales) AS rpt_net
FROM f FULL JOIN r ON f.store_id=r.store_id AND f.d=r.d
WHERE (f.d<=DATE '2025-01-26' OR f.d>=DATE '2025-10-27' OR f.d IS NULL) GROUP BY 1

SELECT 'fact_ret' AS t, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT return_line_id) d, min(return_date) mn, max(return_date) mx, sum(refund_net) amt FROM fact_return_line
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_ret', count(*), count(DISTINCT return_line_id), min(return_date), max(return_date), sum(refund_net) FROM stg_return_line_load
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_sales', count(*), count(DISTINCT sales_line_id), min(sale_date), max(sale_date), sum(net_amount) FROM stg_sales_line_load
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_sales_not_in_fact', count(*), count(DISTINCT sales_line_id), min(sale_date), max(sale_date), sum(net_amount) FROM stg_sales_line_load WHERE sales_line_id NOT IN (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line)
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_ret_not_in_fact', count(*), count(DISTINCT return_line_id), min(return_date), max(return_date), sum(refund_net) FROM stg_return_line_load WHERE return_line_id NOT IN (SELECT return_line_id FROM fact_return_line)

WITH r AS (SELECT s.store_id, r.return_date AS d, sum(r.refund_net) AS ret_fact FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key WHERE s.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT count(*) AS n, sum(CASE WHEN abs(r.ret_fact-coalesce(p.returns_net,0))>0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mismatches, sum(r.ret_fact) AS fact_ret, sum(p.returns_net) AS rpt_ret
FROM r FULL JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales p ON p.store_id=r.store_id AND p.business_date=r.d
WHERE coalesce(r.d,p.business_date) BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25' OR coalesce(r.d,p.business_date) BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26'

SELECT count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', timezone('UTC', sale_ts_utc)) AS DATE) <> sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS date_differs_local, sum(CASE WHEN CAST(sale_ts_utc AS DATE) <> sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS date_differs_utc
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25' OR sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26'

SELECT count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_store, sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date NOT BETWEEN s.valid_from AND s.valid_to THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outside_version
FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25' OR f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26'

WITH cur_store AS (
  -- current version of each store: gives the restated (post 2025-04-28) region for both years
  SELECT store_id, region, open_date FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id < 900
),
lfl_store AS (
  -- comparable stores: open for at least 12 months before the start of the prior-year period (excludes 136 and 137)
  SELECT store_id, region FROM cur_store WHERE open_date IS NULL OR open_date <= DATE '2023-10-28'
),
per AS (
  SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter, min(calendar_date) AS start_date, max(calendar_date) AS end_date
  FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_quarter = 3 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') GROUP BY 1,2
),
sales AS (
  SELECT p.fiscal_year, l.region, sum(f.net_amount) AS gross_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN lfl_store l ON l.store_id=s.store_id
  JOIN per p ON f.sale_date BETWEEN p.start_date AND p.end_date GROUP BY 1,2
),
rets AS (
  SELECT p.fiscal_year, l.region, sum(r.refund_net) AS refunds
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN lfl_store l ON l.store_id=s.store_id
  JOIN per p ON r.return_date BETWEEN p.start_date AND p.end_date GROUP BY 1,2
),
net AS (
  SELECT s.fiscal_year, s.region, s.gross_net - coalesce(r.refunds,0) AS net_sales
  FROM sales s LEFT JOIN rets r ON r.fiscal_year=s.fiscal_year AND r.region=s.region
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_quarter, c.region,
  round(100.0*(c.net_sales/p.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct,
  round(c.net_sales,2) AS cur, round(p.net_sales,2) AS pri
FROM net c JOIN net p ON p.region=c.region AND p.fiscal_year='FY2024/25'
WHERE c.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' ORDER BY c.region

WITH cs AS (SELECT store_id, region FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id<900 AND store_id<>137),
x AS (
 SELECT c.region, c.store_id, CASE WHEN f.sale_date>=DATE '2025-10-27' THEN 'cur' ELSE 'pri' END AS per, sum(f.net_amount) AS v
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN cs c ON c.store_id=s.store_id
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25' OR f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT region,
 round(100*(sum(CASE WHEN per='cur' THEN v END)/sum(CASE WHEN per='pri' THEN v END)-1),2) AS g_incl_136_before_returns,
 round(100*(sum(CASE WHEN per='cur' AND store_id NOT IN (104,119,129,136) THEN v END)/sum(CASE WHEN per='pri' AND store_id NOT IN (104,119,129,136) THEN v END)-1),2) AS g_excl_refit_closed_136_before_returns
FROM x GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
